cases.good: Women tended to participate less than men in village development planning deliberations (31% vs 58%). As reported by Ramadhani et al. (2022), this low participation suggests the presence of structural barriers.

bad.rewrite: Women participated less than men in village development planning deliberations (31% vs 58%). As reported by Ramadhani et al. (2022), this low participation suggests the presence of structural barriers.

Women tended to participate more than men in village development planning deliberations (31% vs 58%). As reported by Ramadhani et al. (2022), this participation pattern suggests the presence of structural barriers.

cases.source: Penggunaan semen PCC dengan 15% abu terbang tidak menurunkan kuat tekan secara signifikan (p > 0,05), tetapi waktu ikat awal bertambah sekitar 40 menit. Pengujian dilakukan pada 36 silinder di laboratorium, bukan di lapangan.
cases.good: Using PCC cement with 15% fly ash did not significantly reduce compressive strength (p > 0.05), but it lengthened the initial setting time by roughly 40 minutes. The tests were conducted on 36 cylinders in the laboratory rather than in the field.
